nodes.label: inet versus cidr
nodes.rationale: inet holds a host optionally with a mask (10 bytes vs 16 as text). cidr is a network only and rejects host bits (22P02 for 192.168.1.10/24). << containment is GiST-indexable. inet normalises IPv6 so equivalent forms compare equal.

nodes.label: Built-in geometric types
nodes.rationale: point, box, polygon, circle and friends with <->, @>, &&, GiST-indexable. Cartesian only — distances on lat/long degrees are not metres. Use PostGIS geography for Earth. point arrives in Node as {x, y}.

nodes.label: citext
nodes.rationale: Case-insensitive text via CREATE EXTENSION citext. UNIQUE rejects case variants with 23505. A forgotten lower() on a text column silently misses rows. Folds case, not Unicode composition.
